(1) The particles issued from rivers are composed of a mixture of terrigeneously derived and anthropogenic materials, the latter being more abundant during dry periods; (2) The particles are mainly composed of fine particles and are characterized by a settling velocity of about 0.5 m d−1; (3) The particles are composed of a complex mixture of metals, some of them being of terrigeneuous origin, others being of industrial and sewage origin.
